## Overview Temporarily disable the CI jobs listed below until their transitive dependencies are locked. Keep the job definitions commented out so they can be restored without reconstructing their configuration. ## Claims | Package installed by job | Disabled jobs | | --- | --- | | `evalscope==1.10.0` | B200/H200 nightly Qwen3.8 accuracy evaluation and MI355 evaluation | | `helion==1.4.0` | H100 and MI250 Helion kernel tests | | `b12x==1.5.1` | DGX Spark nightly b12x linear kernels | | `torchao==0.18.0` / `0.17.0` | H200 MIG, MI300 and MI355 DPX quantization | | `torch-abi-audit==0.0.1` | MI300 Torch Stable ABI Audit | | `tblib==3.1.0` | BMG Example Test that invokes `run-intel-ci-test.sh example` | - Disable both shared definitions/AMD mirrors and the standalone AMD definitions: 15 job declarations, counting mirrors. - Keep the NVIDIA Torch Stable ABI Audit and other Intel jobs enabled. The separate Intel pipeline's Example Test does not invoke the script that installs `tblib`, so it remains enabled. - Record the 42 test files that lose their last CI job in the test-tethering allowlist, each with the dependency-locking reason. ## Validation Passed: ```bash .venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --files \ .buildkite/hardware_tests/intel_xpu_ci/test-intel.yaml \ .buildkite/test-amd.yaml \ .buildkite/test_areas/kernels.yaml \ .buildkite/test_areas/lm_eval.yaml \ .buildkite/test_areas/quantization.yaml \ .buildkite/test_areas/torch_abi.yaml \ tools/pre_commit/test_tethering_allowlist.txt .venv/bin/python tools/pre_commit/check_buildkite_step_keys.py git diff --check ``` Additional local validation parsed every Buildkite YAML file and compared the six changed YAML documents against the base commit: the only semantic changes are removal of the listed job declarations and the AMD-only ABI mirror. The locally available ci-infra `read_steps_from_job_dir` loader successfully loaded 389 steps across all `ci_config*.yaml` configurations. No active targeted package-install command remains in the affected definitions. GPU tests/model evaluations were not run: this changes CI scheduling only, with no model, serving, or test implementation changes. Live Buildkite execution was not tested. ## Details A top-level version pin does not freeze the transitive dependency graph. This is the requested temporary scheduling mitigation, not a dependency-locking fix or a claim that every listed package has a demonstrated vulnerable dependency. The pipeline generator's `Step` model does not support a `skip` field, so this uses the existing commented-out-job convention. Restore the blocks and remove the corresponding temporary allowlist entries once the dependency environments are locked. Coverage is intentionally reduced while these jobs are disabled. Duplicate-work checks searched open PRs for evalscope, Helion, dependency changes, and CI disablement. No existing PR implementing this disablement was found. #63574 updates dependency floors and lockfiles rather than disabling these jobs; #62077 changes sharding and is also distinct. No issue number was supplied. AI assistance was used to prepare and validate this change. ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
